Customer Sales Executive Job at Vono Products Plc




        
    

        
        Vono furniture Products limited was established in 2016 as fully owned subsidiary of Vitafoam Nig. Plc. The Company is positioned to provide furniture products for the Hospitality, Offices & Homes and Institutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Sales Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) and Northern Region, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Customer Sales Executive to drive sales, build strong customer relationships, and contribute to the achievement of company revenue targets.
	The successful candidate will identify sales opportunities, understand customer needs, and provide suitable products or services.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new sales opportunities.
	Respond to customer inquiries and provide accurate product or service information.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers.Meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
	Follow up with prospective customers and convert leads into sales.Prepare quotations, process orders, and maintain accurate customer records.
	Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
	Promote company products and services through calls, emails, social media, and face-to-face interactions.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
	Prepare regular sales reports and provide feedback to management.
	Work closely with other departments to ensure excellent customer service.


Requirements


	Bachelor`s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	Minimum of 4 years of experience in sales
	Must have know how to drive and have a valid license
	Strong negotiation and persuasion abilities.
	Customer-focused and target-driven.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Salary
N100,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CVs to: [email protected] using "Customer Sales Executive- VONO" as the subject of the email.

IT Support (NYSC Associate) Job at Casafina Capital Limited




        
    

        
        Casafina Development Company is a privately held, Africa originated and globally focused alternative asset management firm. We create innovative financing structures and solutions that help our client live their dreams and our investors gain value and return on their investment.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Recruitment& Staffing

Job Position: IT Support (NYSC Associate)

Job Location: Lagos
Job Schedule: Full time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Generate sales lead weekly as per the sales lead generation target. 
	Schedule sales call and presentation based on the leads generated and lead  generation/call ratio
	Coordinate site inspection as the call/inspection ratio. 
	Provide subscription form to new or potential client and ensure receipt of the completed  application. 
	Process received subscription forms and ensure offer letter is sent to new client within  twenty four hours. 
	Forward all required contract and other documents including but not limited to contract of  sales, receipt et.c to the client with 24 hours of payment. 
	Upload all relevant document to the client account on the CRM. ?
	Follow up with client and provide personalized update during the entire sales process  and beyond 
	Other task as may be assigned by the sales manager from time to time  


Requirements


	HND or BSC holder
	NYSC Certificate
	Must have good communication skills (verbal and oral)
	Must have customer centric approach
	Use of CRM software
	Must be adaptable
	Great at networking
	Must have a solution-driven mindset
	Ability to self start
	Good at closing sales transactions with proven results
	Must have worked in a property firm
    

    

        Click here to Apply

Customer Retention Specialist (NYSC Fresh Graduate) Job at Swift Networks Limited




        
    

        
        Swift Networks Limited is a facilities-based telecommunications services provider. The company was founded in 2002, since inception, Swift Networks has invested heavily in “next generation” networking technologies to build a multi-service network platform. Due to rapid expansion, we are looking for a qualified candidate to fill a creative technical position as we hope to maintain our status as the leading broadband connectivity services provider in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Retention Specialist (NYSC Fresh Graduate)
Job Location: Lagos Island and environs, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Workplace type: On-site
     

            
    



About the Role


	We're looking for a dynamic Customer Retention Specialist to help us keep and grow our core customer base.
	You'll speak directly with customers to understand their challenges, resolve issues, gather feedback that improves our services, and build lasting relationships that keep them with us.


What You'll Do


	Resolve customer issues promptly, following established procedures and policies.
	Handle inbound and outbound calls and technical queries on VoIP, internet, and data services across LTE, FTTx, Fibre, and Wi-Fi.
	Use CRM software to manage customer interactions and log every query accurately.
	Escalate complaints to the appropriate teams using the right tools.
	Suggest alternatives and solutions to resolve complaints on a priority basis.
	Develop retention strategies based on customer feedback.
	Negotiate with customers to renew contracts and retain their business.
	Assist customers with online payments and ensure they get value from our services.
	Report customer issues and trends to your Supervisor so management stays informed.
	Attend training and coaching sessions and stay up to date on our products and services.


What We're Looking For


	Bachelor's Degree (Second Class Upper, 2:1) or HND (Upper Credit), preferably in Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
	Currently serving or have completed NYSC (NYSC fresh graduate).
	Must reside on Lagos Island or its environs.
	Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Working knowledge of CRM, Excel, and Outlook.
	Ability to stay calm and professional under pressure.
	Empathy, patience, and strong organizational skills.
	A persuasive attitude and a passion for sales.


Salary and Benefits


	N120,000 monthly.
	Hands-on training and coaching.
	A chance to build a career in the telecoms and internet services industry.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume and a Cover Letter describing your relevant experience and your vision for the role to: [email protected] using "Customer Retention Specialist " as the subject of the email.
